title: brief-citations.md says the symbol check excludes tools/audit/round2/; brief_lint searches it
claim: brief-citations.md says a cited symbol must be found in the tracked tree 'not .claude/ or tools/audit/round2/'; brief_lint.mjs's symbolInTree finds a symbol present only under tools/audit/round2/, since SYMBOL_GREP_EXCLUDE holds ':!.claude' alone.
mechanism: brief_lint.mjs deleted the round2 exclusion when the archive left the tree (its own comment says so); the rule's sentence kept it.

evidence.unit: symbolInTree answer (1 = found) for a symbol planted only under tools/audit/round2/
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb brief_exclude: the temp tree's SYMBOL_GREP_EXCLUDE gains ':!tools/audit/round2'

metric_definition: whether brief_lint's symbolInTree resolves a symbol that exists only under tools/audit/round2/ in a temp baseline tree (1 found, 0 excluded)
phenomenon_property: The exclusions a governance rule states are the exclusions the instrument applies.

null_control.note: the same probe planted only under .claude/ is not found (RESULT claude_symbol_found_null_control=0)

proposed_fix_scope: Edit the Symbols sentence of dev/governance/rules/brief-citations.md to name .claude/ alone, then rules_sync.mjs.
